# NKY Bathroom Refinishing Pros

## About
NKY Bathroom Refinishing Pros refinishes bathtubs, showers, tile surrounds, and countertops for homes and rental properties in Northern Kentucky (Boone, Kenton, and Campbell counties). Free estimates by phone: (714) 494-9486.

## Services
- Bathtub refinishing (porcelain, fiberglass, cast iron), most tubs done in 3-5 hours
- Shower and tile refinishing, any color, ready to use in 24-48 hours
- Countertop refinishing (laminate, cultured marble, tile)

## Service Areas
Florence, Covington, Fort Thomas, Newport, Fort Mitchell, Erlanger, Edgewood, and Independence, Kentucky.
